scope.summary: This standard specifies the general, dimensional, and performance requirements of new pneumatic tyres designed primarily, but not exclusively, for commercial vehicles in categories M2, M3, N, T3, and T4. It explicitly excludes tyres designed for speeds below 80 km/h (identified by corresponding speed symbols).

certification_and_marking.certification_status: According to the product standard text, certification is permissive: conforming tyres 'may be certified' and 'may be marked' with the Standard Mark under the conformity assessment schemes of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. However, to satisfy safety and quality conditions, the standard mandates an exhaustive physical testing and type-approval process alongside permanent, indelible sidewall markings.

requirements.detail: Product(s) conforming to the requirements of this standard may be certified as per the conformity assessment schemes under the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016, and marked with the Standard Mark.

Tyres must be permanently marked (moulded, engraved, or etched) on both sidewalls (or at least the outer sidewall for asymmetrical tyres) with the manufacturer name/trade-mark, tyre size designation, speed symbol, ply rating/load index, cold inflation pressure, 'TUBELESS' (if applicable), and date of manufacture.
The date of manufacture must be permanently marked on at least one sidewall either as a Week and Year code (e.g., '2510' for the 25th week of 2010) or a Month and Year code (e.g., 'MAR 10').

The tyre must include at least six transverse rows of tread wear indicators (minimum of four rows for rims with diameter code <= 12) spaced equally in the principal grooves. TWIs must indicate with a tolerance of +0.60/-0.00 mm when the grooves are worn down to 1.6 mm, and their location must be indicated by sidewall markings.
Any engraving or etching of mandatory markings must be executed directly during the manufacturing process of the tyre, and not later than 24 hours after the tyre is removed from its mould.

To achieve type-approval, sample tyres must satisfy dimensions checks, plunger strength testing (minimum breaking energy in Joules per Table 30/31), endurance testing on a test drum without interruption (Clause 4.2), and high-speed load/speed performance testing (Clause 4.3).

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 15636:2022 is the national Indian Standard specification establishing general, dimensional, and performance criteria for new pneumatic tyres intended for commercial vehicles (categories M2, M3, N, T3, and T4). It applies to both diagonal (bias-ply) and radial-ply tyre designs rated for speeds of 80 km/h or higher. To verify safety compliance, the standard mandates comprehensive laboratory type testing—including a high-impact plunger test to measure structural casing strength, continuous test-drum endurance runs under varying load ratios, and high-speed load/speed performance trials. When selecting or inspecting these products, engineers must confirm that the tread-wear indicator marks are positioned correctly to signal when tread depth is unsafe (<= 1.6 mm), check that required markings are deeply and durably engraved within 24 hours of vulcanization, and verify that the tyre's size, load index, and speed ratings correspond to the certified parameters.
